title: Didn't fulfill as promised
text: The first box arrived the day after Christmas for my husband.  It did contain 5 treats.  It did not contain one scrap of information as promised in the promo material.  We think these may be from Thailand?  Anyway, I have access to many foreign grocery stores and could just go buy random treats off the shelf with no explanation all by myself.  It was the explanation part that really grabbed me on this item.  So I cancelled.  Idea is good, execution failed.
label: neutral
